description:
We are actively seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the nursing team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This critical leadership role offers a competitive salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 per year, reflecting the importance of the position and the expertise required. We are looking to fill this role quickly with a candidate who is passionate about delivering exceptional patient care and fostering a supportive environment.

As the Director of Nursing, you will be instrumental in overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of care, and maintaining regulatory compliance. This is an excellent opportunity for a proven nursing leader to make a significant impact within a dynamic healthcare setting.
requirements: Valid Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 2 years of nursing leadership experience, preferably as a DON or ADON
Experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care facility
Strong understanding of state and federal healthcare regulations
Excellent leadership, communication, and organizational skills

description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced MDS Coordinator to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Des Moines, IA. This full-time role offers a competitive hourly rate and the opportunity to contribute significantly to resident care planning and regulatory compliance. We are looking for a stable, long-term team member, not an interim placement.In this vital position, you will be responsible for coordinating and completing the Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessments, ensuring accuracy and timeliness in accordance with federal and state regulations. Your expertise will be crucial in developing comprehensive care plans that reflect the needs of our residents.If you are an RN with a passion for detailed assessment and a commitment to quality care, we encourage you to apply. Join a team that values your skills and offers a supportive environment.
requirements: Minimum of 1-2 years experience as an MDS Coordinator in a skilled nursing facility
Proficient in the Resident Assessment Instrument (RAI) process and Medicare/Medicaid regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $36.00 - $40.00 based on experience.

facilityType: A premier health and rehabilitation center
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced MDS Coordinator to join a reputable skilled nursing facility in Des Moines, IA. In this vital role, you will be responsible for coordinating the Minimum Data Set (MDS) assessment process, ensuring accurate and timely completion of assessments in accordance with federal and state regulations. Your expertise will be crucial in optimizing resident care plans and facilitating appropriate reimbursement.

This position requires a professional who can collaborate effectively with an interdisciplinary team, maintain meticulous documentation, and contribute to a high standard of care. We are looking for a candidate who is passionate about compliance and committed to improving resident outcomes.
requirements: Prior experience as an MDS Coordinator in a skilled nursing facility
Proficiency with the Resident Assessment Instrument (RAI) process and MDS 3.0
Strong understanding of Medicare and Medicaid regulations

description:
We are seeking a dedicated Internal Medicine-Pediatrics Physician to join a leading community health center in Greenville, SC. This is an exceptional opportunity to provide comprehensive care within a supportive environment, offering a highly competitive compensation package and robust benefits.

This role comes with a revamped compensation and raise structure, ensuring a rewarding career path. Enjoy great benefits, including generous Paid Time Off (PTO), alongside a salary significantly above the state average for Family Medicine physicians. We are open to candidates requiring travel or relocation.

We are actively reviewing all qualified Physician candidates for consideration, with a preference for full-time commitment.
requirements: Doctor of Medicine (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO) degree
Board Certification or Eligibility in Internal Medicine, Pediatrics, or Family Medicine
Current or eligible for medical licensure in the state of South Carolina
salaryOrBonusInfo: This role offers a highly competitive compensation package starting at $210,000 annually, with an additional $25,000 guaranteed bonus and a further $25,000 in potential bonuses, totaling up to $260,000. A $9,000 sign-on/relocation bonus is available, payable on the first payday upon signing a promissory note. This compensation structure is significantly above the state average for Family Medicine physicians in South Carolina.
